findings.detail: The strict release resolves ten reviewed non-binding references through one hash-bound receipt.
The deterministic preview is valid for one evidence-backed UPDATE; the active vault content is unchanged because the release records lineage for the existing note.
Only genai-guardrails is in scope; questions, taxonomy, indexes and sources remain outside the release.
The proposed control guidance must not be read as a legal obligation.
Approval is required for this exact candidate before integration.
